claim: The demonstrated pipeline uses embeddings to narrow a large category set before an LLM chooses the final category.
The UI separates narrowing failures from final selection failures so each stage can be improved independently.
Classification correctness is subjective when labels differ by specificity or are close siblings.
A table based review UI makes individual failures and evaluator judgments visible.
The speakers recommend rapidly building the UI and eval harness to learn before optimizing implementation quality.
A raw accuracy percentage can mislead when the reviewer lacks domain knowledge or the answer key itself is debatable.
